AC-05: validate protected requirement — Mobile Build presents `Specification`, `Plan`, `Implementation`, `Build`, `Test`, `Verify`, and `Review` in order, deriving completed/current/pending/failed presentation only from the current Work Specification and Engineering Run server state. No client-only simulated stage progress is permitted.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Mobile Build provides access to available run events, tests, code/diff/terminal/evidence or Live Build details through progressive disclosure without promoting Observability to a fourth primary mobile destination and without changing desktop Observability behavior.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Mobile Project clearly identifies the active Project/conversation and supports existing conversation/project switching and creation behavior through existing canonical APIs. It creates no competing client-owned Project identity or repository binding.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — When protected state requires operator input and one clear next action exists, the mobile presentation gives that action visual priority. Secondary actions remain available but visually subordinate; action availability continues to come from existing protected state and APIs.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Each mobile primary screen and dedicated detail surface uses one primary vertical scroll container. Compact Work Specification content no longer introduces a nested vertical ScrollView inside Chat, and the composer remains practically reachable above the keyboard and bottom navigation.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Existing authentication, session expiry handling, Project identity/binding, Work Specification approval, Engineering Run lifecycle, source lineage, provider authority, protected evaluation, `REVIEW` / `HUMAN_REQUIRED` ceiling, reduced-motion/reduced-graphics behavior, and desktop/tablet UX contracts remain unchanged.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Client typecheck/state/export and existing browser/Skia acceptance pass, and deterministic mobile coverage verifies navigation, specification review, guided Build state, Project switching, and amendment recovery at representative phone widths.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Representative narrow-phone acceptance verifies no overlapping primary controls, no hidden primary action or composer, accessible labels for the three destinations and critical actions, and practical touch targets for primary mobile controls.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Mobile primary navigation
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: At widths below 760px, Parallax exposes exactly three primary destinations named `Chat`, `Build`, and `Project`, with the current destination visually and accessibly unambiguous. Non-compact desktop/tablet navigation remains unchanged.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Conversation-first mobile Chat
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Mobile Chat keeps the conversation and composer as the dominant surface, shows current Project context and user-facing `Ask`/`Build` mode language, and does not inline the complete Work Specification, Engineering Run panel, or Observability workspace.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Dedicated Work Specification review
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: A mobile user can open a dedicated specification detail surface that contains the complete current objective, acceptance criteria, constraints, open questions, risks, revision/status, and permitted approval action. The detail surface uses one primary vertical scroll container and the compact Chat surface does not create a nested Work Specification scroller.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Plain-language specification amendment recovery
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: When the protected conversation state is `SPEC_AMENDMENT`, mobile explains that the new request changes the approved build, makes `Start new objective` the dominant action, and retains an available path back to the current approved scope when the existing protected API permits it. Server guard and inheritance semantics remain unchanged.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Authoritative guided Build lifecycle
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Mobile Build presents `Specification`, `Plan`, `Implementation`, `Build`, `Test`, `Verify`, and `Review` in order, deriving completed/current/pending/failed presentation only from the current Work Specification and Engineering Run server state. No client-only simulated stage progress is permitted.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Progressive engineering evidence
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Mobile Build provides access to available run events, tests, code/diff/terminal/evidence or Live Build details through progressive disclosure without promoting Observability to a fourth primary mobile destination and without changing desktop Observability behavior.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Clear Project context and switching
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Mobile Project clearly identifies the active Project/conversation and supports existing conversation/project switching and creation behavior through existing canonical APIs. It creates no competing client-owned Project identity or repository binding.

protected_acceptance_map.title: One dominant contextual action
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: When protected state requires operator input and one clear next action exists, the mobile presentation gives that action visual priority. Secondary actions remain available but visually subordinate; action availability continues to come from existing protected state and APIs.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Single-scroll mobile interaction
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Each mobile primary screen and dedicated detail surface uses one primary vertical scroll container. Compact Work Specification content no longer introduces a nested vertical ScrollView inside Chat, and the composer remains practically reachable above the keyboard and bottom navigation.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Protected contracts and desktop regression safety
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Existing authentication, session expiry handling, Project identity/binding, Work Specification approval, Engineering Run lifecycle, source lineage, provider authority, protected evaluation, `REVIEW` / `HUMAN_REQUIRED` ceiling, reduced-motion/reduced-graphics behavior, and desktop/tablet UX contracts remain unchanged.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Deterministic mobile acceptance coverage
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Client typecheck/state/export and existing browser/Skia acceptance pass, and deterministic mobile coverage verifies navigation, specification review, guided Build state, Project switching, and amendment recovery at representative phone widths.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Phone viewport usability
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Representative narrow-phone acceptance verifies no overlapping primary controls, no hidden primary action or composer, accessible labels for the three destinations and critical actions, and practical touch targets for primary mobile controls.
